name: pdf-tools
description: Read, create, merge, split and fill PDF files, and extract their text and tables. Use when the user mentions a PDF or asks to produce one.

name: docx-editor
description: Create and edit Word documents (.docx), including tracked changes, comments and formatting. Use when the user asks for a Word file or attaches one.

name: frontend-design
description: Build polished web interfaces and components with strong visual design. Use when the user asks for a web page, UI component, landing page or styling changes.

name: webapp-testing

name: mcp-builder
description: Guide for creating Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that expose tools, resources and prompts in Python or TypeScript. Use when the user wants to build a new MCP server or integrate an API through MCP.

name: data-visualization
description: Turn data into clear charts and dashboards with good color and labeling. Use when the user asks for a chart, graph, plot or dashboard.

name: git-workflow
description: Branching, commits, rebasing, resolving merge conflicts and opening pull requests with git and GitHub. Use when the user asks for help with git commands or a PR.

name: writing-coach
description: Edit prose for clarity and tone: emails, essays, cover letters and announcements. Use when the user asks to write, rewrite or polish text.
